verdict.rationale: Teller is an API-first product. It documents public REST endpoints for balances, transactions, identity, account details, and Zelle payments, with mTLS client-certificate auth, pagination, idempotent requests, webhooks, and a simulated sandbox. A community user reports building an export script against the 'super easy to use API'. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec or llms.txt (probes returned 404), and API-based webhook registration rather than dashboard-only configuration.
